title: SC suggests Parliament to bring amendment to section 26E of SARFAESI Act
description:
The Supreme Court on Thursday said Parliament should consider bringing an appropriate amendment to section 26E of the SARFAESI Act and that an explanation of the expression "all other debts" in the provision may be provided authoritatively.
Section 26E of the SARFAESI Act, 2002, gives secured creditors priority to recover their debts ahead of other debts and government dues once a security interest is registered.
A bench of Justices J B Pardiwala and Ujjal Bhuyan made the suggestion while referring a legal question -- whether the "deposits" sought to be recovered under the Maharashtra Protection of Interest of Depositors (in Financial Establishments) Act would fall within the ambit of the expression "all other debts" appearing in section 26E of the SARFAESI Act -- to a three-judge bench.
